source_boundary: Only published aggregate measurements and POST-regime regenerated development outputs from the permitted July 22-26 window were reduced to market-day and whole-date summaries. No underlying row, filename inventory, or substitute from July 27-31, August 1-3, or August 6-19 was opened. The published 19-of-54 and 3-of-53 headlines and protected-slice support counts are inputs, not recomputed reserved-window results.

effect_evidence.interpretation: The retrain targets the stale prior and contiguous class support, but downstream serving absorbed most of the measured raw correction and the point-in-time forecast repair is small and cool-signed. The honest served planning range is therefore zero through the measured 5.39% gap closure; zero remains plausible.

endpoints.label: Pooled all-hour Brier
endpoints.measure: paired candidate-minus-incumbent daily-first Brier across all capture hours

fleet.variance_evidence: Three allowed forward-chained development dates from the published all-hour gated-candidate OOF output; a lower-variance proxy, not an effect estimate for the retrain.
fleet.variance_method: two-way date and market clustered variance converted to an equivalent per-date standard deviation

toronto.variance_evidence: The published all-hour gate copied Toronto exactly, so its zero deltas are not a variance estimate. The permitted Toronto 09:00-14:00 date variation is used as the conservative surrogate.

endpoints.label: 09:00-14:00 Brier
endpoints.measure: paired candidate-minus-incumbent daily-first Brier at effective cutoffs 09:00 through 14:00

fleet.cluster_unit: whole fleet target date with equal market-day weight
fleet.variance_evidence: Five permitted leave-one-date-out served-conditional development folds, aggregated market-day first and then as one whole-fleet date.
fleet.variance_method: two-way date and market clustered variance converted to an equivalent per-date standard deviation

toronto.variance_evidence: The same five permitted OOF folds restricted to Toronto; the diagnostic transform worsened Toronto on all five date point estimates and is used only for variance.

endpoints.label: Frozen severe-tail SSE
endpoints.measure: candidate-minus-incumbent squared error on incumbent-frozen severe band rows

fleet.cluster_unit: whole fleet target date with frozen-tail band weighting retained inside date
fleet.variance_evidence: Five published permitted date-fold fixed-tail SSE deltas from the served conditional correction.
fleet.variance_method: two-way date and market clustered variance over the 55 tail-bearing market-days, converted to an equivalent per-date standard deviation

toronto.variance_evidence: Five permitted Toronto frozen-tail date means; only 39 severe rows exist and the date effects are highly unstable.

slice_gate.current_rule: Fail if any observed protected-slice candidate-minus-incumbent point estimate exceeds the pooled point improvement.

primary_endpoint.name: Fleet 09:00-14:00 paired daily-first Brier difference
primary_endpoint.definition: For every countable reserved target date, average snapshot-first 11-band Brier within each market-day at effective cutoffs 09:00-14:00, give each of the 12 registered market-days equal weight, and retain the candidate-minus-incumbent fleet-date difference as the single independent observation.
primary_endpoint.decision_rule: One-sided alpha 0.05 test of mean fleet-date difference below zero over the complete frozen reservation using two-way date/market cluster-robust inference and degrees of freedom capped by the 12-market dimension, with no interim look or endpoint switch. A win additionally requires every unchanged deterministic safety, parity, release, trusted-floor, probability-mass, newly-severe, and corrected protected-slice harm gate to pass.
